info.name: equis-assessment
info.description:
Riding Schedule — E4 assessment (M3, M4) against equis-api: GET /assessment/slots, POST /me/members, GET /me/assessment/slots/{id} and POST /me/bookings/{id}/result.

Before running:
1. Dev database with V1–V13 applied and an assessment template (one without a level) whose sessions are generated, with an open slot in the next two weeks. Trainer 1 is active.
2. trainerLogin / trainerPassword default to seeded trainer 1. For the 403 checks, set adminEmail and adminPassword (prefer a Postman environment); without them those requests are skipped.
3. Run in school time (Africa/Cairo): the date variables are computed in the runner's local zone.

Run order: 0 → 4. Folder 1 picks the open slot, folder 2 books a new member into it (one member and one seat per run; there is no delete), folder 3 reads it back, folder 4 tries to record a result.
The result's success path (200, then result_already_recorded) runs only when trainer 1 has a booking from last week still waiting; it then creates a rider. Not covered here: slot_full, slot_closed, member_already_booked, not_assessor and booking_cancelled, which need data the API cannot set up from one trainer.

item.name: 0 · Sign in
item.description: Run first. Saves trainerAccessToken, the date variables, and adminAccessToken when adminEmail is set.

request.description: Saves trainerAccessToken (valid for 15 minutes) and today / inTwoWeeks / lastWeek / toTooFar.

exec: // Local dates; the server uses school time (Africa/Cairo), so run this in that zone.
const day = n => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + n); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); };

item.name: 1 · Slot list (A1, A2)
item.description: GET /assessment/slots. The same list for every trainer.

request.description: Saves openSlotId: the first open slot, as A1 preselects it.

exec: // A full slot is never open.
pm.test("Each day holds slots of that date", () => days.forEach(d => { pm.expect(d.slots).to.not.be.empty; d.slots.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.date).to.eql(d.date)); }));
pm.test("Days in date order, slots in start order", () => { const keys = slots.map(s => s.date + " " + s.start); pm.expect(keys).to.eql([...keys].sort()); });
pm.test("Every slot has the contract fields", () => slots.forEach(checkSlot));
pm.test("Every slot is inside the range", () => slots.forEach(s => pm.expect(s.date >= b.from && s.date <= b.to).to.be.true));
pm.test("There is an open slot to book into", () => pm.expect(open, "needs an upcoming assessment slot with a free seat").to.exist);

item.name: 4 · Record a result (A5)
item.description: POST /me/bookings/{id}/result. The booking from folder 2 is in a slot that hasn't started, so it is refused; the success path runs only on a booking from last week that is still waiting. Placing creates a rider.
